content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: ABIOC(ITDR-010 Anomalous Privileged Directory Role Assignment by Non-Governance Identity) AND ABIOC(ITDR-010 High-Risk OAuth Consent and App Credential Grant Deviating from Baseline) — fuses the two auto-tuned behavioral deviations on the same tenant+identity into a single rogue-privilege-escalation incident anchored to the sync/automation-account causality chain.
rules.name: Rogue Privilege Escalation on Sync Account — ABIOC Causality Stitch
